title: Seed packet template
subject: English
source: Written for english/y2 lesson 104 (Seed packet template (pupil PDF, printable))
intro: Lesson 104: Writing instructions to grow a seed, with a seed packet design. Listen, look, then do the tasks with a grown-up.

parts.text: You will need: cress seeds, cotton wool, a saucer and water.
1. Carefully put damp cotton wool on the saucer.
2. Sprinkle the seeds thinly on top.
3. Place the saucer on a light window sill.
4. Gently keep the cotton wool damp. Tip: your cress is ready in about a week!

panels.title: Seed packet design
points: Front: plant name and a picture
Add: when and where to plant

panels.title: Check it
points: Does each step start with a bossy verb?

keywords.def: steps that tell you how to do something
the name at the top: How to...
a bossy verb that gives an order
a small paper bag that holds seeds and tells you how to grow them

questions.q: Core: write your instructions: title, You will need, four numbered steps
Extend: add a tip at the end
questions.a: For example: Tip: turn the saucer each day so the cress grows straight.

questions.q: Stretch: design the front of your seed packet with the plant's name

options: 2. Sprinkle the seeds thinly on top.
questions.a: B) 2. Sprinkle the seeds thinly on top.. It starts with a bossy verb and says exactly what to do and how.
